newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco buys 40,000T soft wheat at $178.5, $168.5.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 40,000T soft wheat at $178.5, $168.5.

text.p: Moroccan trader Gromic said on Friday it had bought 20,000 tonnes of optional soft wheat for delivery January 1-20 at $168.5, and another 20,000 tonnes for November delivery at $178.5, both C&F.
The order for January delivery was made on Thursday and the November delivery order earlier this month, a spokeswoman for the Casablanca-based trader said.
Both shipments are for delivery at Casablanca port.
